avoid_supplements.name: Domperidone
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive dopamine antagonism increases risk of tardive dyskinesia and extrapyramidal side effects
avoid_supplements.action: Do not use concurrently; select alternative prokinetic agent

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer reduces metoclopramide plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 14-day washout if switching

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin B6 (>200mg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase risk of peripheral neuropathy when combined with metoclopramide's known neurological effects
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin B6 supplementation to <100mg/day; monitor for paresthesias

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both have prokinetic properties; additive GI effects possible but generally beneficial for nausea management
caution_supplements.action: May be used cautiously together; monitor for GI symptoms

caution_supplements.name: 5-HTP
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive serotonergic effects; theoretical risk of serotonin syndrome is minimal at therapeutic doses
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Alcohol potentiates CNS depression and increases risk of sedation, dizziness, and impaired coordination
avoid_foods.action: Counsel patient to avoid alcohol consumption during metoclopramide therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gastric emptying and reduce absorption rate of metoclopramide; decreases therapeutic effect onset
caution_foods.action: Take metoclopramide 30 minutes before meals with water for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may increase metoclopramide metabolism via CYP1A2; excessive intake may reduce efficacy
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine consumption; monitor therapeutic response if high intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor for tardive dyskinesia, extrapyramidal symptoms, and depression especially with prolonged use >3 months. Counsel on CNS effects and advise against driving/operating machinery until effects are known. Patient should report involuntary movements, restlessness, or mood changes immediately.
